en: Monochrome postcard showing a grand military parade passing in front of an ornate neo‑Renaissance stone building. Cavalry officers ride horses along a broad avenue while large crowds of civilians and soldiers watch from the street, the steps, balconies, and windows of the building. The façade features rusticated stonework, arched windows, heavy balustrades, and large sculpted atlantes supporting the balcony. The image is bordered below by a tonal scale and measurement marks, suggesting this is a reproduction of an old postcard.
